rtc.click: This is your IP. Click it to test the WebRTC transmission
webrtc.configuration.public.tooltip: If the server should be accessible from the internet. Why would you ever turn this off? If you do, you can only access the server from your local network.
webrtc.configuration.quit_page.tooltip: When you quit your game, all connected browsers will go to this site. Leave empty to do nothing. Set to space to reload their page.
webrtc.configuration.autostart.tooltip: Automatically start the WebRTC server when your game starts
webrtc.configuration.stun_url.tooltip: Change this if you have your own STUN server. Don't change it if you have no idea!
webrtc.configuration.port.tooltip: The port you connect to. If you have a firewall, make sure this port is open! DuckDuckGo'e "PORT FORWARDING" if unsure
webrtc.configuration.title: Internet Page Title
webrtc.configuration.title.tooltip: "*" will be replaced with the window title. (so "WebRTC *" will become "WebRTC Minecraft")
webrtc.configuration.bitrate.tooltip: Quality of the video. Higher is better, but requires more bandwidth
webrtc.configuration.fps.tooltip: Maximum Video FPS. Higher is better, but requires more bandwidth. Set to 0 to disable the FPS limit
webrtc.configuration.res.tooltip: Reduce Video Resoulution. Lower resolution is better for lower bandwidth, but will look worse. Can be useful when the game is running at a higher resolution than the browser
webrtc.configuration.videosend.tooltip: If you turn this off, the browser wont see your game. Why would you ever turn this off?
webrtc.configuration.videoget.tooltip: If you turn this off, the browser wont not see your game. Why would you ever turn this off?
webrtc.configuration.audioqueue.tooltip: How much Audio gets Buffered. Better leave this config Alone
webrtc.configuration.audiosend.tooltip: If you turn this off, the browser cant hear your game. Why would you ever turn this off?
webrtc.configuration.audioget.tooltip: If you turn this off, the browser cant hear your game. Why would you ever turn this off?
webrtc.configuration.input.tooltip: What browsers can control and see
webrtc.configuration.restartbutton.toolt: When the Button should be visible at the up-right corner of your Titlescreen
webrtc.configuration.mausms.tooltip: How often the Browser sends mouse-movement (in miliseconds). Low values can send too much and lag the connection, high values make the mouse feel jittery
webrtc.configuration.hideip.tooltip: When your IP should be hidden at the up-right corner of your Titlescreen
